decisions.rationale: duplicate_row_rate 0.0 and the product of airport_code's 3 distinct values and observed_hour_utc's 4341 distinct values (13023) closely matches row_count 13014, indicating one row per airport per UTC hour.

purpose: silver_airport_weather holds hourly weather observations for the three New York City area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) from January through June 2013, paired with static reference attributes about each airport, at one row per airport per observed UTC hour.
usage: Consumers should read the table at its (airport_code, observed_hour_utc) grain, joining on airport_code to obtain static reference fields (airport_name, airport_municipality, airport_elevation_ft, airport_longest_runway_ft) and treating observed_hour_local/observed_date_local as local-time derivations of observed_hour_utc. Consumers must handle nulls in wind_dir_degrees (1.68%), wind_speed_mph (0.02%), wind_gust_mph (74.55%), and pressure_mb (11.50%), since these columns are not guaranteed populated.
limitations: The profile cannot confirm which column combination is the true primary key; (airport_code, observed_hour_utc) is proposed from row_count and distinct_count evidence but is unverified until a deterministic grain measurement confirms it. wind_gust_mph is missing for roughly three-quarters of rows and pressure_mb for about one-eighth, so analyses using them must account for sparse coverage. The captured_at column is a pipeline-generated extraction timestamp rather than observed weather data and is retained for provenance; none of the profiled columns are flagged is_airbyte_metadata true, but captured_at's name and tightly clustered values suggest pipeline origin and warrant reviewer confirmation. Reference columns (airport_name, airport_municipality, airport_elevation_ft, airport_longest_runway_ft) are treated as closed sets based on only three observed airports; if additional airports are added later these accepted-value rules would need to be revisited.
